about: Phase 8 attribution decisions, taken by reading the printed page (tool/literature/apply_attribution_decisions.py). The audit's new signature check found one published record whose verse the book signs with another poet's name.

decisions.evidence: The quatrain «Абр ҳамегиряд чун ошиқон…» is signed «(Шаҳиди Балхӣ)» on the line under it. Phase 7 filed it under Абушакури Балхӣ, whose biography cites the page; the signature under the verse was not read then.
